datasets.description: Yemen Medium Term Projection FEWS NET Acute Food Insecurity Classifications Geographic data for 2020. [Source: This metadata record was automatically extracted from the Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX); Original dataset: https://data.humdata.org/dataset/yemen_medium_term_projection__fewsnet_ipc_shapefile_for_2020]
datasets.purpose: IPC Classification spatial data in different IPC scenarios collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a regular schedule (typically monthly).

lineage.description: FEWS NET enumerators conducted regular (typically monthly) field assessments across Yemen to classify acute food insecurity conditions using the IPC framework. Geographic data representing classified areas and IPC phases were compiled into monthly medium-term projection datasets for 2020, distributed as GeoJSON and KML formats.
